# Barış Akıntı — barishizm.eu

> Personal website of Barış Akıntı (also written M. Barış Akıntı), an Artificial Intelligence Systems student at Vilnius Gediminas Technical University (VILNIUS TECH) in Vilnius, Lithuania, and AI Engineer Intern at INTERIP NETWORKS B.V. The site showcases AI/ML projects with write-ups, a blog, CV-style experience and contact information. All content is available in English (root URLs) and Turkish (under /tr/); each language has its own URLs.

The site is fully static (HTML/CSS/vanilla JS), hosted on GitHub Pages.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.barishizm.eu/): Introduction and the three top projects
- [About](https://www.barishizm.eu/about): Bio, focus areas (machine learning, computer vision, data engineering, web development) and skills
- [Projects](https://www.barishizm.eu/projects): Eight open-source AI/ML and web projects with GitHub links, live demos and write-ups
- [Blog](https://www.barishizm.eu/blog): Notes on artificial intelligence, machine learning and AI agents
- [Experience](https://www.barishizm.eu/experience): Education, experience, certificates, technical skills and languages
- [Contact](https://www.barishizm.eu/contact): E-mail, social profiles and a contact form

## Project write-ups

- [Chest X-Ray Pneumonia Detection](https://www.barishizm.eu/project/chest-xray): Educational comparison of a classical machine learning pipeline (SVM, RandomForest, ensemble) and a fine-tuned ResNet18 on chest X-rays, with Grad-CAM heatmaps. Not a clinical tool.
- [Limited Search (AI Search Engine)](https://www.barishizm.eu/project/ai-search-engine): AI answer engine built as one Next.js app; Gemini streams answers grounded in Google Search with numbered citations. Live at https://www.limited-search.com
- [Age Detection with OpenCV DNN](https://www.barishizm.eu/project/age-detection): Detects faces and classifies each into one of eight age ranges with pretrained models, from an image or a webcam.

## Projects

- [AI Search Engine](https://github.com/barishizm/AI-Search-Engine): Next.js + Gemini answer engine with Google Search grounding, Supabase auth and rate limits (TypeScript). Live: https://www.limited-search.com
- [Chest X-Ray Diagnosis](https://github.com/barishizm/chest_xray): Classical ML vs fine-tuned ResNet18 on chest X-rays with Grad-CAM (Python); educational, not clinical
- [Spotify Recommender](https://github.com/barishizm/Spotify-Recommendation-System): Content-based music recommendation with cosine similarity over audio features (Python, Streamlit). Live: https://spotify-recommendation-sys-1.streamlit.app
- [Age Detection](https://github.com/barishizm/Age-Detection): Face detection and age-range classification with OpenCV's DNN module (Python)
- [Image Super-Resolution](https://github.com/barishizm/Image-Super-Resolution): Upscales image quality by 2–5×
- [News Data Scraping](https://github.com/barishizm/news-data-scraping): Tracks how Hacker News talks about AI companies, with sentiment analysis per company (Python, Streamlit). Live: https://news-data-scraping.streamlit.app
- [Smart Student Portal](https://github.com/barishizm/Smart-Student-Portal): Admin-only student-records portal (Node.js, Express, EJS, SQLite, XML/XSLT)
- [Gemini API Project](https://github.com/barishizm/ai-project-gemini): Clean, minimal Gemini API implementation in Python

## Blog

- [Hello, World](https://www.barishizm.eu/posts/hello-world): Introductory post — why the site exists and what to expect (2026-07-01)
- [How Does Machine Learning Work?](https://www.barishizm.eu/posts/machine-learning): Introduction to machine learning as a subfield of AI — algorithms and models that learn from data (2026-07-02)
- [What is Deep Learning?](https://www.barishizm.eu/posts/deep-learning): An introduction to deep learning and its applications (2026-07-06)
- [Who are These Agents?](https://www.barishizm.eu/posts/agents): What AI agents are, how they differ from a chatbot, and the think-act-observe loop behind them (2026-07-11)
- [RSS feed](https://www.barishizm.eu/feed.xml): All blog posts as an RSS feed
